description:
Deletes the given related work for the given version.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Resolve issues:* and *Edit issues* [Managing project permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/adminjiraserver/managing-project-permissions-938847145.html) for the project that contains the version.

parameters.description: The ID of the version that the target related work belongs to.
parameters.name: versionId

parameters.description: The ID of the related work to delete.
parameters.name: relatedWorkId

204.description: Returned if the related work is deleted.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description:
Returned if

the authentication credentials are incorrect.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.

404.description: Returned if the version/related work is not found.
